notes.title: HOSTYLE Playtest Patch 3
notes.notes:
[p]Thank you guys again for another super successful demo, this time at San Japan! This patch is another QOL patch refining the game even further. For the next updates we plan on adding more to the existing content in the game for a vertical slice that will establish the foundation of the full game before we move into making the rest of the major content. Please stick with us! 

(These following changes have technically existed for a week)
[/p][list][*][p]Agent Cryptic's model has been slightly updated! 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329328/2442f47ac58014bc7860c4deab1e268ecf700b1b.png"][/img][/p][p](before and after!)[/p][/*][*][p]Trial 1 has been completely redone!
[/p][/*][*][p]DASH now has a auto aim mechanic, if you aim a dash near a pole, bubble, spike, etc, you will now 
home in on it slightly
[/p][/*][*][p]Added a flyover camera to the start of time-trials to better illustrate where the player needs to go
[/p][/*][*][p]Updated checkpoint mechanic to place you in more predictable locations
[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly reworked the cove hub
[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new NPC to the hub
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that let you cancel out of the respawn animation
[/p][/*][*][p]Respawning at a player made checkpoint now properly respawns you on the ground
[/p][/*][*][p]Two new songs have been added to the time trial levels
[/p][/*][*][p]Moved the location of the buckethead's seashell mission
[/p][/*][/list][p]
(Newest Changes, following San Japan)
[/p][list][*][p]Added a camera sensitivity slider in the controls menu
[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the placement of certain actors in the cove making 2 of the CD missions nearly impossible (they're now very possible)
[/p][/*][*][p]Using RT on controller now snaps the camera to the direction the player is facing
[/p][/*][*][p]Respawning at a player made checkpoint now sets the camera orientation in the intended direction
[/p][/*][*][p]Added more checkpoints in the cove to reduce frustration
[/p][/*][*][p]Cryptic now spawns atop a spike in trial 3
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed controller indicator not showing on ? kiosks
[/p][/*][*][p]PHIA's dialogue in the tutorial stage now has a camera pan to better illustrate how to progress
[/p][/*][*][p]Input is properly taken away from players in intro cutscenes of trials
[/p][/*][*][p]Made dialogue trigger box bigger for PHIA in the cove
[/p][/*][*][p]Launch bubbles now properly rotate you in the direction you shoot out from, making it easier to ledge grab after
[/p][/*][*][p]Updated UI of the logs screen to be more readable
[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: HOSTYLE Playtest 2 Patch 2
notes.notes: [p]This update adds some new content and quality of life changes for those that enjoy the speedrunning gameplay, hope you guys enjoy!   [/p][p]Again our discord server can be found here: [url="https://discord.gg/FP7Gpu2UHR"]https://discord.gg/FP7Gpu2UHR[/url][/p][list][*][p]  Added the TERMINAL to the starting area of the hub world, simply walk up to open a menu that lets you quickly play the different time-trial levels[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329328/53a8c1e666f88314a782306b849a7349fa5a493f.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Added 4 new EXPERIMENTAL time-trials to the terminal, these are unfinished levels that will be rotated out over time[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329328/fc42fbc7c83e8f69ff7d497b331583139241529f.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]If there are no active checkpoints, failing or using tab will reset the timer to 0[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the charge slide (for now)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated colors of UI buttons to alleviate confusion[/p][/*][*][p]Pausing the game now pauses the in-game timer (duh)  [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: HOSTYLE Playtest 2 Patch 1
notes.notes: [p]A new patch is available for the playtest which fixes many small issues in the previous version. Thank you to everyone who tried the game out at Classic Games Fest![/p][p][/p][p] If you're not aware, HOSTYLE now has a community discord! [url="https://discord.gg/FP7Gpu2UHR"]https://discord.gg/FP7Gpu2UHR[/url]  [/p][p][/p][p]-Wall-Kick is now temporarily mapped to a different button (left-click/right face button) to not interfere with ledge-grab, this will return to the jump button down the line when a better fix is made [/p][p]-Dialogue boxes will now fill in the text box when a button is pressed rather than skipping to the next dialogue box instantly [/p][p]-PHIA's dialogue in the tutorial is now skippable [/p][p]-Bomguin has an increased pickup area [/p][p]-Bomguin now properly collides with the walls of the cliffside area [/p][p]-Altered time-trials 1 and 2 to be a bit simpler[/p][p]-Moved up death plane in Level 1 [/p][p]-Removed some soft locks from the tutorial level [/p][p]-Fixed bug where checkpoint respawns would sometimes clip you through the world [/p][p]-Fixed bug where text boxes would persist through loading screens [/p][p]-Fixed bug where dialogue would advance to the next text box unexpectedly [/p][p]-Fixed a bug involving the timer not resetting when using the restart button[/p][p]-Cracked walls now have a more obvious texture to illustrate that they can be exploded [/p][p]-Diminished the blue fog effect and made shadows have more contrast in certain levels [/p][p]-Updated the ring race so that the path is more straightforward[/p][p][/p]
